title: Abstract Version Control System
description: Abstract version control system (git) into a VersionControlProvider interface with checkpoint, checkin, checkout operations. Implement GitVersionControlProvider. Rename SourceControlProvider to use the VCS abstraction. Replace git.commit hooks with version.checkpoint hooks. Add version.checkin and version.checkout events.

interactions.author: 🧑‍💻usalu
interactions.prompt: Abstract version control system (git) into a VersionControlProvider interface with checkpoint, checkin, checkout operations. Implement GitVersionControlProvider. Rename SourceControlProvider to use the VCS abstraction. Replace git.commit hooks with version.checkpoint hooks. Add version.checkin and version.checkout events.

interactions.author: 🧑‍💻usalu
interactions.summary: Abstracted version control system: renamed SourceControlProvider to VersionControlProvider with Checkpoint/Checkin/Checkout/CurrentBranch/StagedFiles/StageAll methods. Implemented GitVersionControlProvider. Replaced git.commit.* hooks with version.checkpoint/checkin/checkout starting/ended events. Added HookKindVersion. Added 12 unit tests including provider methods, helper functions initTestGitRepo/initTestGitRepoWithRemote, and dispatch tests. All tests pass.
